sketches.mechanism: NULL participates in three-valued logic: NULL = NULL evaluates to UNKNOWN, and WHERE admits only TRUE rows.
sketches.resonance: Even absence cannot prove it is identical to itself, so the query for sameness returns nothing.

sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation allows a self-referential infinite list to be defined, and only the demanded head is evaluated.
sketches.resonance: Forever can be present without ending, because only the smallest piece of it is ever asked to arrive.

sketches.mechanism: Nothing is the bottom type, so a non-returning expression can type-check as any required type.
sketches.resonance: What can become anything does so only by never becoming at all.
